# Muse

> Muse is an EEG headband platform for real-time brain training, meditation, and sleep optimization powered by neurofeedback technology and AI coaching.

Muse offers wearable EEG devices (Muse 2 and Muse S Athena) that provide neurofeedback for meditation, focus, sleep tracking, and cognitive performance. The platform includes a mobile app with guided meditations, an AI brain coach (Enso), and a professional management system for practitioners.

## Key Topics

- EEG (electroencephalography)
- Neurofeedback
- Brain training
- Muse S Athena
- Muse 2
- Deep Sleep Boost
- Enso AI brain coach
- Mental fitness
- Sleep tracking
- Cognitive performance
- Alpha Peak brainwave tracking
- Brain Recharge Score
- fNIRS technology
- Stress management
- Meditation app
